_readme: Manual special-request cards for the Warehouse Board (wall.html). A card shows while today's date is within [from, to] inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Fields: id (unique), lodge, kind (ownerout | ownerin | note | check), title, message (the warning text shown on the card), when (the date it actually happens, shown as a relative label like 'Tomorrow'), from, to. Edit this file and commit to update the board; delete an entry once it's no longer needed.

notes.title: Owner departing
notes.message: Owner normally strips our bedding and uses their own, and usually cleans the lodge themselves. CHECK whether there's a laundry bag to make up, and whether a turnaround clean is actually needed.
